title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha falsely claims that she had an abortion, prompting her family to accuse Nila of overworking her. Later, Chozhan angrily questions Cheran for failing to support Nila.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Sankar frees Karthik from restaurant trouble and asks Aadhavan and Arjun to support him. As Arjun gets a sales meeting lead, Sankar hears news about Pooja's whereabouts.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Maha demands her money back from Rajeshwari, giving her a 30-day deadline. Meanwhile, Kanmani overhears Anbu's heartfelt confession of love and feels her baby move.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel asks Saravanan to invite Muthuvel's family to his baby's naming ceremony, but Saravanan refuses. Sakthivel worries as an ailing Muthuvel asks him to accept Gomathi.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: As Ragu's plot drives the drivers away, Meena offers Muthu a part-time hiring solution. Meanwhile, Vijaya rejoices when the matrimony agency finds a suitable match for Manoj.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Favourite musicians elevate the Juniors' battle for the last finale ticket. With judges impressed by the musical brilliance, anticipation grows as the final spot awaits its winner.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
episodeTitle: Vetri and Abinaya Under One Roof
description: Obeying a court order, Vetri stays at Shanmugam's house, where Abinaya warns him to stay away. Meanwhile, Shanmugam prays for unity while Sudar tries to comfort Vetri.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Following the election announcement, Kalamma pressures Manikandan to repay his loan. Desperate, Manikandan and his wife attempt to end their lives, but Paraman saves them.
